radii.description:
Candidate FRST voting radii, in pixels; at least one, each at least 1.

The single source of truth for the radii the pipeline votes over:
`advanced.frst` carries no radii of its own (`detect_circles` combines
the two to build the working FRST config).

polarity.description:
Which polarity to detect.

The single source of truth for voting and extraction polarity:
`advanced.frst` carries no polarity of its own.

radius_hint.description:
Approximate expected radius used as the initial circle hypothesis,
in pixels; must be greater than 0.

Used for scoring and refinement when a proposal has no per-proposal
radius from the FRST scale map.

min_score.description: Minimum support score to keep a detection (in `[0, 1]`).

roi.description:
Optional rectangular region of interest.

When set, the whole pipeline (gradient, voting, scoring, refinement) runs
only inside this rectangle, and the returned detection centers are
translated back to full-frame image coordinates. `None` / `null` (the
default) searches the entire image. An out-of-bounds rectangle is a hard
error.

Polarity.description: Controls which gradient polarity is used during voting and scoring.

oneOf.description: Scharr 3x3 (weights 3-10-3). Better rotational symmetry than Sobel.

Rect.description: An axis-aligned integer rectangle in image pixel coordinates.

x.description: Left edge (column) in pixels. `x + width` must not exceed the image width.

y.description: Top edge (row) in pixels. `y + height` must not exceed the image height.

width.description: Width in pixels; must be at least 1.

height.description: Height in pixels; must be at least 1.

frst.description:
FRST voting tuning (alpha, gradient threshold, smoothing).

`radii` and `polarity` are *not* part of this tuning: the pipeline takes
them from the top-level `radii` and `polarity` fields (see
`FrstTuning::to_frst_config`).

alpha.description:
Radial strictness exponent (alpha); must be at least 0. Higher values
require more consistent orientation evidence. Default: 2.0.

gradient_threshold.description:
Minimum gradient magnitude to participate in voting. Pixels with
`|g| < gradient_threshold` are skipped. Default: 0.0 (all pixels vote).

Magnitudes scale with the input's value range (Sobel/Scharr units of
the raw pixel values), so a threshold tuned for 8-bit data is ~256x too
small for raw 16-bit data.

smoothing_factor.description:
Standard deviation of the Gaussian smoothing kernel applied per-radius,
relative to the radius: `sigma = smoothing_factor * radius`; must be
greater than 0. Default: 0.5.

radius.description:
Suppression radius in pixels (half-window size); must be at least 1.

A peak must be strictly greater than every pixel within this distance.
The window `2 * radius + 1` must fit inside the image, otherwise no
proposals are returned.

threshold.description:
Minimum response value for a pixel to be considered a candidate.

Units are those of the voting response map, not pixels.

max_detections.description: Maximum number of proposals kept after suppression (budget cap); must be at least 1.

min_samples.description:
Minimum number of valid gradient samples; a candidate with fewer is
flagged degenerate and rejected. Must be at least 1.

weight_ringness.description:
Weight of the ringness (gradient alignment) component in the total
score; must be at least 0. The total is clamped to `[0, 1]`.

weight_coverage.description:
Weight of the angular coverage component in the total score; must be
at least 0. The total is clamped to `[0, 1]`.

num_angular_samples.description:
Number of angular samples around the annulus; must be at least 4.
Also sets the number of angular bins used for the coverage score.

num_radial_samples.description: Number of radial samples across the annulus width; must be at least 1.

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of refinement iterations; must be at least 1.

convergence_tol.description:
Convergence tolerance: stop when center shift < this (pixels); must be
greater than 0.

max_center_drift.description:
Maximum allowed total center drift as a fraction of the initial radius;
must be greater than 0.

If the refined center moves farther than `max_center_drift * radius`
from the initial center, refinement stops with `RefinementStatus::OutOfBounds`.

annulus_margin.description:
Fractional annulus margin around the hypothesized radius, used to
re-estimate the radius each iteration; must be greater than 0.
E.g., 0.3 samples from `0.7*r` to `1.3*r`.

radial_center.description: Radial center config for center refinement sub-step.

sampling.description: Annulus sampling config for radius estimation.

patch_radius.description:
Half-width of the patch around the seed (in pixels); must be at least 1.
The full patch is `(2*patch_radius+1)²`.

gradient_threshold.description:
Minimum gradient magnitude to include a pixel in the fit; must be at
least 0.

Magnitudes scale with the input's value range, so the threshold is
bit-depth dependent (see `gradient_threshold` of the FRST tuning).
